g.text: Generalization boundaries: (1) V3's confirmed gain is analytic (Yld91) only and did not transfer to the physical TL1 truss; (2) the B1/B2 207-axis candidate library caps any
method at ~1.2–1.3× over maximin (oracle bound); (3) the advantage is tied to the frozen constant-mean GP; (4) B1/B2 references (72, covering radius 14.7°) cannot exclude narrow features;
(5) TL1 is one deterministic truss RVE with 9 matched starts: a reproducible case study, not a generalization; cusps remain under-resolved by every method at n = 64.
